# American Society of Cinematographers (ASC)

> > The American Society of Cinematographers (ASC) is a professional organization dedicated to advancing the art and craft of cinematography through education, awards, publications, and community.

Founded in Hollywood, the ASC promotes excellence in cinematography through its prestigious ASC Awards, the American Cinematographer magazine and Manual, the ASC Clubhouse at 1782 North Orange Drive, and educational programs including master classes and mentorship. The organization also maintains the ASC Relief Fund and offers ASC+ subscription services for cinematography professionals and enthusiasts.
